translated_text: Prague, March 2nd, 1:36 AM. Babus, it was truly a great joy that you gave me with the photos. I had to look at them again and again because you received them. We really turned out funny, almost everyone. Unfortunately, it was an unforgivable mistake on my part with most of the pictures, despite using Pan film with a self-disc. As a result, many very nice little details have disappeared. Next time, something like that shouldn't happen again. Meanwhile, the films have also arrived, but there is still some excellent material available. You will get more. In any case, I would never have thought that Baba could be so pretty - of course, only in pictures. Is that due to the girl's photos or the photographer's skill? – Let's talk about the photos. Thank you very much, my dear. Once again, my birthday went very nicely and with gifts. There was a lot, including gramophone records, shirts, towel fabric, shawls, ties, perfume, etc., and from Ja Ellen a wonderful Montblanc fountain pen and lots of diligent writing, all in a case with a very nice letter. She only mentions my last letter very briefly, in which she considers part of it tasteless. But she didn't take it badly. She's going to Palestine this summer. Today I was at the Elekta Film Company, Prague 1, Narodny tr. 26 (Mr. Auerbach). He was very nice and will look through the book. He would have preferred it in German, but it will work this way too. If you have time off, send it to me or him. He also wants to send it to Berlin. He told me to contact various film producers. Well, we'll see. I have two more people here I'd like to show the book to. Of course, I'll leave all decisions regarding possible film rights up to them. I'm also sending the attached photos. Write to me soon and tell me how you're doing: how you're feeling and how it is. Lots of love, Bob. I'll send the film back in three weeks when I don't need it anymore. Elisabeth Aigner, Paris 15th arrondissement, 6.9 bis Rue Grancion, Prague 13th district, Ruska
